"""Generate clean SVG charts (pure Python, no external deps)."""
import pandas as pd
import html

BLUE = '#2E86AB'; RED = '#E63946'; GREEN = '#2A9D8F'
GRAY = '#6C757D'; GOLD = '#E9C46A'; DARK = '#333333'

def esc(s): return html.escape(str(s))

def svg_header(w, h, title, subtitle=None):
    out = [f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{w}" height="{h}" viewBox="0 0 {w} {h}" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif">',
           f'<rect width="{w}" height="{h}" fill="white"/>']
    out.append(f'<text x="24" y="34" font-size="21" font-weight="bold" fill="{DARK}">{esc(title)}</text>')
    if subtitle:
        out.append(f'<text x="24" y="56" font-size="13" fill="{GRAY}">{esc(subtitle)}</text>')
    return out

def svg_footer(s, note=None):
    out = [f'<text x="24" y="{s+40}" font-size="11" fill="{GRAY}">Source: eu_economic_data.csv · EU member states + EU total, 2022–2024</text>']
    if note:
        out.append(f'<text x="24" y="{s+56}" font-size="11" fill="{GRAY}">{esc(note)}</text>')
    out.append('</svg>')
    return out

# ============================================================
# CHART 1 — Headline line chart: Inflation vs GDP growth (EU)
# ============================================================
def chart1():
    eu = pd.read_csv('eu_economic_data.csv')
    eu = eu[eu['Country']=='EU_Total'].sort_values('Year')
    W, H = 920, 520
    L, R, T, B = 90, 40, 100, 70
    pw, ph = W-L-R, H-T-B
    ymin, ymax = -1.5, 11.0
    def X(yy): return L + pw*(yy - eu['Year'].min())/(eu['Year'].max()-eu['Year'].min())
    def Y(v): return T + ph*(ymax-v)/(ymax-ymin)
    out = svg_header(W, H, "Europe's 2022–2024 arc: inflation crushed, growth stalled",
                     "EU total — CPI inflation vs. real GDP growth (%)")
    # gridlines + y labels
    for v in range(0, 11, 2):
        out.append(f'<line x1="{L}" y1="{Y(v):.1f}" x2="{W-R}" y2="{Y(v):.1f}" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="1"/>')
        out.append(f'<text x="{L-10}" y="{Y(v)+4:.1f}" font-size="12" fill="{GRAY}" text-anchor="end">{v}%</text>')
    # x labels
    for y in eu['Year']:
        out.append(f'<text x="{X(y):.1f}" y="{H-B+22}" font-size="13" fill="{DARK}" text-anchor="middle">{y}</text>')
    # ECB target line
    out.append(f'<line x1="{L}" y1="{Y(2.0):.1f}" x2="{W-R}" y2="{Y(2.0):.1f}" stroke="{GRAY}" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6,4"/>')
    out.append(f'<text x="{W-R-4}" y="{Y(2.0)-7:.1f}" font-size="11" fill="{GRAY}" text-anchor="end">ECB target: 2%</text>')
    # inflation line
    pts = ' '.join(f'{X(y):.1f},{Y(i):.1f}' for y, i in zip(eu['Year'], eu['Inflation_Pct']))
    out.append(f'<polyline points="{pts}" fill="none" stroke="{RED}" stroke-width="3.5"/>')
    for y, i in zip(eu['Year'], eu['Inflation_Pct']):
        out.append(f'<circle cx="{X(y):.1f}" cy="{Y(i):.1f}" r="6" fill="{RED}"/>')
        out.append(f'<text x="{X(y):.1f}" y="{Y(i)-14:.1f}" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="{RED}" text-anchor="middle">{i:.1f}%</text>')
    # growth line
    pts = ' '.join(f'{X(y):.1f},{Y(g):.1f}' for y, g in zip(eu['Year'], eu['GDP_Growth_Pct']))
    out.append(f'<polyline points="{pts}" fill="none" stroke="{BLUE}" stroke-width="3.5"/>')
    for y, g in zip(eu['Year'], eu['GDP_Growth_Pct']):
        out.append(f'<rect x="{X(y)-6:.1f}" y="{Y(g)-6:.1f}" width="12" height="12" fill="{BLUE}"/>')
        out.append(f'<text x="{X(y):.1f}" y="{Y(g)+24:.1f}" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="{BLUE}" text-anchor="middle">{g:+.1f}%</text>')
    # annotations
    out.append(f'<text x="{X(2022)-14:.1f}" y="{Y(9.6):.1f}" font-size="12" fill="{GRAY}">Energy price shock</text>')
    out.append(f'<text x="{X(2022)-14:.1f}" y="{Y(8.95):.1f}" font-size="12" fill="{GRAY}">(war in Ukraine)</text>')
    out.append(f'<text x="{X(2024)-10:.1f}" y="{Y(6.4):.1f}" font-size="12" fill="{GREEN}" font-weight="bold">Back to target without</text>')
    out.append(f'<text x="{X(2024)-10:.1f}" y="{Y(5.85):.1f}" font-size="12" fill="{GREEN}" font-weight="bold">a jobs crisis</text>')
    # legend
    out.append(f'<rect x="{L}" y="{T-44}" width="16" height="3" fill="{RED}"/><text x="{L+22}" y="{T-38}" font-size="13" fill="{DARK}">Inflation</text>')
    out.append(f'<rect x="{L+130}" y="{T-46}" width="12" height="12" fill="{BLUE}"/><text x="{L+148}" y="{T-38}" font-size="13" fill="{DARK}">Real GDP growth</text>')
    out += svg_footer(H)
    return '\n'.join(out)

# ============================================================
# CHART 2 — 2024 growth ranking (horizontal bars)
# ============================================================
def chart2():
    df = pd.read_csv('eu_economic_data.csv')
    g = df[(df['Country']!='EU_Total') & (df['Year']==2024)].sort_values('GDP_Growth_Pct')
    W, H = 920, 480
    L, R, T, B = 170, 60, 90, 60
    maxv = 4.0
    def X(v): return L + (W-L-R)*v/maxv
    row_h = (H-T-B)/len(g)
    out = svg_header(W, H, "2024 growth leaders & laggards: Spain soars, Germany stalls",
                     "Real GDP growth by country, 2024 (%)")
    for i, (_, r) in enumerate(g.iterrows()):
        cy = T + i*row_h + row_h/2
        v = r['GDP_Growth_Pct']
        color = GREEN if v > 1.5 else (BLUE if v >= 0 else RED)
        bw = abs(X(v) - X(0))
        x0 = X(0) if v >= 0 else X(0)-bw
        out.append(f'<text x="{L-14}" y="{cy+5}" font-size="14" fill="{DARK}" text-anchor="end" font-weight="bold">{r["Country"]}</text>')
        out.append(f'<rect x="{x0:.1f}" y="{cy-row_h*0.28:.1f}" width="{bw:.1f}" height="{row_h*0.56:.1f}" fill="{color}" rx="4"/>')
        out.append(f'<line x1="{X(0):.1f}" y1="{T-6}" x2="{X(0):.1f}" y2="{H-B+6}" stroke="{DARK}" stroke-width="1.2"/>')
        tx = X(v) + (14 if v >= 0 else -14)
        out.append(f'<text x="{tx:.1f}" y="{cy+5}" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="{DARK}" text-anchor="{"start" if v>=0 else "end"}">{v:+.1f}%</text>')
    for vv in [-1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4]:
        out.append(f'<text x="{X(vv):.1f}" y="{H-B+22}" font-size="12" fill="{GRAY}" text-anchor="middle">{vv}%</text>')
    out.append(f'<text x="{X(2.4):.1f}" y="{H-B+40}" font-size="12" fill="{GRAY}" text-anchor="middle">Real GDP growth 2024</text>')
    # Germany annotation
    g_row = g[g['Country']=='Germany'].iloc[0]
    cy = T + g.index.get_loc(g_row.name)*row_h + row_h/2
    out.append(f'<text x="{W-R-6}" y="{cy-16}" font-size="12" fill="{RED}" text-anchor="end">only major EU economy in recession</text>')
    out.append(f'<path d="M {W-R-6} {cy-10} L {X(0)-8:.1f} {cy-4}" stroke="{RED}" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" marker-end="none"/>')
    out += svg_footer(H)
    return '\n'.join(out)

# ============================================================
# CHART 3 — Debt trajectories
# ============================================================
def chart3():
    df = pd.read_csv('eu_economic_data.csv')
    focus = ['Italy', 'Spain', 'France', 'EU_Total', 'Germany']
    d = df[df['Country'].isin(focus)].pivot(index='Year', columns='Country', values='Public_Debt_Pct_GDP')
    W, H = 920, 520
    L, R, T, B = 90, 190, 90, 70
    ymin, ymax = 25, 150
    def X(yy): return L + (W-L-R)*(yy-2022)/2
    def Y(v): return T + (H-T-B)*(ymax-v)/(ymax-ymin)
    styles = {'Italy': (RED, 'o'), 'Spain': (GREEN, 's'), 'France': (GOLD, '^'),
              'EU_Total': (DARK, 'D'), 'Germany': (BLUE, 'v')}
    out = svg_header(W, H, "Fiscal consolidation in action — except France",
                     "Public debt as % of GDP, selected economies, 2022–2024")
    for v in range(30, 151, 20):
        out.append(f'<line x1="{L}" y1="{Y(v):.1f}" x2="{W-R}" y2="{Y(v):.1f}" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="1"/>')
        out.append(f'<text x="{L-10}" y="{Y(v)+4:.1f}" font-size="12" fill="{GRAY}" text-anchor="end">{v}%</text>')
    for y in [2022, 2023, 2024]:
        out.append(f'<text x="{X(y):.1f}" y="{H-B+24}" font-size="13" fill="{DARK}" text-anchor="middle">{y}</text>')
    for c, (col, mk) in styles.items():
        pts = ' '.join(f'{X(y):.1f},{Y(v):.1f}' for y, v in d[c].items())
        out.append(f'<polyline points="{pts}" fill="none" stroke="{col}" stroke-width="2.8"/>')
        for y, v in d[c].items():
            r = 5.5
            out.append(f'<circle cx="{X(y):.1f}" cy="{Y(v):.1f}" r="{r}" fill="{col}" stroke="white" stroke-width="1.5"/>')
        out.append(f'<text x="{X(2024)+12:.1f}" y="{Y(d[c].iloc[-1])+4:.1f}" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="{col}">{c} — {d[c].iloc[-1]:.1f}%</text>')
    # France annotation
    out.append(f'<text x="{X(2022)-8:.1f}" y="{Y(130):.1f}" font-size="12" fill="#B08A1E">France: the only country where debt rose</text>')
    out.append(f'<text x="{X(2022)-8:.1f}" y="{Y(125):.1f}" font-size="12" fill="#B08A1E">(111.8% → 112.0%)</text>')
    out += svg_footer(H)
    return '\n'.join(out)

# ============================================================
# CHART 4 — Trade balance 2024
# ============================================================
def chart4():
    df = pd.read_csv('eu_economic_data.csv')
    tb = df[(df['Country']!='EU_Total') & (df['Year']==2024)].sort_values('Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR')
    W, H = 920, 470
    L, R, T, B = 170, 80, 90, 60
    maxv = 95
    def X(v): return L + (W-L-R)*v/maxv
    row_h = (H-T-B)/len(tb)
    out = svg_header(W, H, "The two Europes: surplus North vs. deficit South & West",
                     "Trade balance 2024, billion EUR")
    for i, (_, r) in enumerate(tb.iterrows()):
        cy = T + i*row_h + row_h/2
        v = r['Trade_Balance_Billion_EUR']
        color = GREEN if v >= 0 else RED
        bw = abs(X(v) - X(0))
        x0 = X(0) if v >= 0 else X(0)-bw
        out.append(f'<text x="{L-14}" y="{cy+5}" font-size="14" fill="{DARK}" text-anchor="end" font-weight="bold">{r["Country"]}</text>')
        out.append(f'<rect x="{x0:.1f}" y="{cy-row_h*0.28:.1f}" width="{bw:.1f}" height="{row_h*0.56:.1f}" fill="{color}" rx="4"/>')
        tx = X(v) + (12 if v >= 0 else -12)
        out.append(f'<text x="{tx:.1f}" y="{cy+5}" font-size="13.5" font-weight="bold" fill="{DARK}" text-anchor="{"start" if v>=0 else "end"}">{v:+.1f}B €</text>')
    out.append(f'<line x1="{X(0):.1f}" y1="{T-6}" x2="{X(0):.1f}" y2="{H-B+6}" stroke="{DARK}" stroke-width="1.2"/>')
    for vv in [-80, -60, -40, -20, 0, 20, 40, 60, 80]:
        out.append(f'<text x="{X(vv):.1f}" y="{H-B+22}" font-size="11" fill="{GRAY}" text-anchor="middle">{vv}</text>')
